llm_response.reason: The website, hosted on the subdomain of a legitimate Indonesian high school, presents content unrelated to education. Instead, it mimics a well-known e-commerce platform (Lazada), displays excessive discounting (99% off), encourages the download of suspicious apps, offers an unusually wide range of unrelated products, uses unverified business info, and the branding connects to a known gambling/lottery scam (RAJASLOTO). Hijacking legitimate educational infrastructure for a fake shopping/gambling portal, along with urgent download prompts and fabricated customer service details, matches several classic scam website indicators.
